SEC EDGAR data (U.S. government work, public domain), trimmed to the concepts in the
concept maps and to periods ending on or after 2021-01-01. Selected and trimmed by
open-finance-mcp (MIT, (c) 2026 Nathanael Johnson) at commit 8bcf3af0; see
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Yahoo chart fixtures from that repo are deliberately not included.

2026-11-10: concepts the concept maps added since (amortization of intangible assets, minorities, lease liabilities,
costs and expenses, debt maturities, IFRS EPS fallbacks, among others) were added from SEC's companyfacts, only for
filings already in each file (same accession numbers) and periods ending on or after 2021-01-01. Facts already here
were left as they were.
